title: 425 - Valley Bank Holding Vote Results
filingText:
UNITED STATES SECURITIES AND EXCHANGE COMMISSION
FORM 8-K
Date of Report: April 5, 2026
Valley Bank Holding Corp.
Written communications pursuant to Rule 425 under the Securities Act

Introductory Note
On April 5, 2026, Valley Bank Holding Corp. held a special meeting of stockholders in connection with the Agreement and Plan of Merger with Coast Financial Corp.

Item 5.07. Submission of Matters to a Vote of Security Holders.
At the close of business on February 28, 2026, the record date for the Special Meeting, there were 56,959,141 shares of Valley voting common stock outstanding. At the Special Meeting, the holders of 46,694,968 shares were represented in person or by proxy, constituting a quorum. Proposal 1 - Valley share issuance proposal was approved with 46,211,799 votes for, 469,418 votes against and 13,751 abstentions. Proposal 2 - Valley incentive plan proposal was approved with 43,750,562 votes for, 2,842,515 votes against and 101,891 abstentions. No adjournment of the Special Meeting was determined to be necessary or appropriate.
